EstimateView.description: Roadmap J2 — one property's cost estimate.

basis.description: The measured table row, with its evidence.

confidence.description: `high` | `medium` | `low` — for `low`, size for the band's top.

memory_class.description: `small` (no exact BDD work) | `medium` (within the default arena) | `large` (the arena may overflow, or the cap ladder runs).

PlanPropertyView.description: Roadmap J2 — one property of a plan.

no_estimate_reason.description: mununu#941 — why `routing` is absent (the model or the formula did not parse for the planner, or the cone width could not be established). Absent when `routing` is present.

not_run.description: mununu#939 — the run would not execute this row, and why (resumed from the breadcrumb, or left out by the row selection). Such a row is counted under `not_run` in `bands`.

routing.description: The planner's routing facts with the cost estimate; absent when the cone width could not be established (no width, no prediction — mununu#577).

RoutingView.description: The planner's per-property routing facts (roadmap J4): what `plan-cost` says, as fields.

cap.description: The exact engine's effective bit cap for that cone.

cone_bits.description: The exact engine's cone-of-influence bit width for the property's atoms.

diameter_log2.description: The widest in-cone down-counter (≈ 2^W diameter), when one is found.

estimate.description: Roadmap J2 — the cost estimate: a band, a memory class, a confidence and the measured table row it came from. A scheduler hint; nothing reads it on a verdict path.

predicted_engine.description: The engine the planner predicts will decide the property.

shape.description: Roadmap J2 — the static shape the cost estimate is keyed by.

ShapeFactsView.description: Roadmap J2 — the static shape of one property (read off its cone and formula, no solving).

alternation.description: The formula's fixpoint alternation depth (2 = a μ under a ν).

arith_ops.description: Multiplier / divider / remainder cells in the cone.

constant.description: The formula is constant on every model.

UnsupportedAssertionView.description: An assertion outside the supported fragment (mirrors `UnsupportedAssertion`).

description: Roadmap J2 — `POST /api/v1/sv/plan` and `sv verify-auto --plan-only --json`: what a run of the same request would verify and what each property is estimated to cost, from the lift and the planner alone — no engine runs.

bands.description: How many properties carry an estimate, per band — the run's shape at a glance.

build.description: The binary's commit, as in the run's report (absent when it registered none).

lift_ms.description: The lift's wall, milliseconds — paid once per run, not per property.

properties.description: Every property the run would verify, in report order.

unsupported.description: Assertions that did not translate (as in the run's report).

title: SvPlanResponse
